repository_sources_git_ref.name: repository_sources_git_ref
repository_sources_git_ref.value: "repository_sources"."git_ref" IS NULL OR length("repository_sources"."git_ref") BETWEEN 1 AND 255

source_snapshots_object_ids.name: source_snapshots_object_ids
source_snapshots_object_ids.value: length("source_snapshots"."commit_sha") = 40 AND "source_snapshots"."commit_sha" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND length("source_snapshots"."tree_sha") = 40 AND "source_snapshots"."tree_sha" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'

standards_draft.name: standards_draft
standards_draft.value: ("standards"."draft_document" IS NULL) = ("standards"."draft_lock_version" IS NULL) AND ("standards"."draft_document" IS NULL) = ("standards"."draft_saved_at" IS NULL) AND ("standards"."draft_document" IS NOT NULL OR "standards"."draft_based_on_release_id" IS NULL)

evaluations_complete_result.name: evaluations_complete_result
evaluations_complete_result.value: "evaluations"."state" <> 'complete' OR ("evaluations"."summary" IS NOT NULL AND length("evaluations"."result_digest") = 64)

evidence_index_lines.name: evidence_index_lines
evidence_index_lines.value: ("evidence_index"."location_kind" = 'lines') = ("evidence_index"."line_start" IS NOT NULL AND "evidence_index"."line_end" IS NOT NULL)

profile_versions_head_commit.name: profile_versions_head_commit
profile_versions_head_commit.value: "profile_versions"."head_commit" IS NULL OR (length("profile_versions"."head_commit") = 40 AND "profile_versions"."head_commit" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')

jobs_lease.name: jobs_lease
jobs_lease.value: ("jobs"."state" = 'running') = ("jobs"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "jobs"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

preview_builds_package_dir.name: preview_builds_package_dir
preview_builds_package_dir.value: "preview_builds"."package_dir" = '.' OR (length("preview_builds"."package_dir") BETWEEN 1 AND 1024 AND "preview_builds"."package_dir" NOT GLOB '/*' AND "preview_builds"."package_dir" NOT GLOB '*/' AND "preview_builds"."package_dir" NOT GLOB '*//*' AND ('/' || "preview_builds"."package_dir" || '/') NOT GLOB '*/./*' AND ('/' || "preview_builds"."package_dir" || '/') NOT GLOB '*/../*')

preview_builds_ref.name: preview_builds_ref
preview_builds_ref.value: "preview_builds"."ref_kind" IN ('branch', 'tag', 'commit') AND ("preview_builds"."ref_kind" = 'commit') = ("preview_builds"."ref_name" IS NULL) AND ("preview_builds"."ref_name" IS NULL OR length("preview_builds"."ref_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 255)

preview_builds_artifact_layout.name: preview_builds_artifact_layout
preview_builds_artifact_layout.value: artifact_layout IS NULL OR artifact_layout IN ('standalone', 'module_federation', 'single_spa')

preview_builds_artifact.name: preview_builds_artifact
preview_builds_artifact.value: ("preview_builds"."artifact" IS NULL) = ("preview_builds"."artifact_attempt" IS NULL) AND ("preview_builds"."artifact" IS NULL) = ("preview_builds"."artifact_layout" IS NULL) AND ("preview_builds"."artifact" IS NULL) = ("preview_builds"."artifact_entry" IS NULL) AND ("preview_builds"."artifact" IS NULL) = ("preview_builds"."output_bytes" IS NULL) AND ("preview_builds"."artifact" IS NULL) = ("preview_builds"."build_ms" IS NULL) AND ("preview_builds"."artifact" IS NULL) = ("preview_builds"."node_version" IS NULL) AND ("preview_builds"."artifact" IS NULL) = ("preview_builds"."package_manager" IS NULL)

preview_builds_sizes.name: preview_builds_sizes
preview_builds_sizes.value: ("preview_builds"."output_bytes" IS NULL OR "preview_builds"."output_bytes" >= 0) AND ("preview_builds"."build_ms" IS NULL OR "preview_builds"."build_ms" >= 0)

preview_preparations_ref.name: preview_preparations_ref
preview_preparations_ref.value: "preview_preparations"."ref_kind" IN ('branch', 'tag', 'commit') AND ("preview_preparations"."ref_kind" = 'commit') = ("preview_preparations"."ref_name" IS NULL) AND ("preview_preparations"."ref_name" IS NULL OR length("preview_preparations"."ref_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 255)

preview_preparations_profile_digest.name: preview_preparations_profile_digest
preview_preparations_profile_digest.value: "preview_preparations"."profile_digest" IS NULL OR (length("preview_preparations"."profile_digest") = 64 AND "preview_preparations"."profile_digest" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')

preview_preparations_profiling.name: preview_preparations_profiling
preview_preparations_profiling.value: "preview_preparations"."state" <> 'profiling' OR ("preview_preparations"."packages" IS NULL AND "preview_preparations"."refusal" IS NULL AND "preview_preparations"."failure" IS NULL AND "preview_preparations"."finished_at" IS NULL)

preview_preparations_decided.name: preview_preparations_decided
preview_preparations_decided.value: "preview_preparations"."state" NOT IN ('ready', 'refused') OR ("preview_preparations"."profile_digest" IS NOT NULL AND ("preview_preparations"."repository_profile_id" IS NULL) <> ("preview_preparations"."profile_document" IS NULL) AND "preview_preparations"."packages" IS NOT NULL AND "preview_preparations"."failure" IS NULL AND "preview_preparations"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL AND ("preview_preparations"."state" = 'refused') = ("preview_preparations"."refusal" IS NOT NULL))

preview_preparations_failed.name: preview_preparations_failed
preview_preparations_failed.value: "preview_preparations"."state" <> 'failed' OR ("preview_preparations"."failure" IS NOT NULL AND length("preview_preparations"."failure") > 0 AND "preview_preparations"."refusal" IS NULL AND "preview_preparations"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL)
